name: Planner
author: brodgar
description: Example addon (V4/V5): the LAYOUT + GRID-ANCHORED PERSISTENCE + MOVE demo for client-only world ghosts (hafen.ghost). A small city/base planner — place translucent 'blueprint' ghosts over the real terrain, CLICK them to select (V2), MOVE them with the mouse snapped to the placegrid (V5, ':planner grab'), rotate/remove them, and SAVE the layout so it reloads at the SAME spot after a relog. Ghosts are SAFE-tier (a Gob with no server id, D-029): nothing reaches the server, so this addon declares NO permissions and is default-enabled like 'hello'. Persistence is GRID-ANCHORED: world coords are login-relative, so each ghost is saved as hafen.map.gridPos(x,y) => {gridId, x, y} (a stable cross-session grid id + within-grid offset) and re-resolved on load with hafen.map.fromGridPos(anchor) (nil until that grid streams in — retried), the same rule map markers follow. Commands: ':planner place [name|res]' drops the current/named blueprint at your feet (clickable + saved); 'blueprint [name]' shows/sets it (bare = list the palette); 'list' shows the placed ghosts; 'select <n>' selects #n (or CLICK a ghost); 'grab' MOVES the selected ghost with the mouse (placegrid-snapped, CLICK to drop — feels like placing a building, D-033); 'rotate [deg]' turns the selected one (persisted); 'remove [n]' / 'clear' / 'save'. Kept SEPARATE from the read-only 'hello' regression harness as the dedicated V-series example (spec 16-virtual-entities, D-031).
